test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Armature and Coil Winder) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A can complete a piece of work in 18 days. B can complete it in 14 days. With the assistance of C, they completed the work in 7 days. C alone can complete it in ______________ days.
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the work in 18 days

B can complete the work in 14 days

A + B + C together complete the work in 7 days

**Calculations:**

⇒ LCM of 18, 14, 7 = 126

Let total work = 126 units

⇒ A’s 1 day work = 126 ÷ 18 = 7

⇒ B’s 1 day work = 126 ÷ 14 = 9

⇒ (A + B + C)’s 1 day work = 126 ÷ 7 = 18

⇒ C’s 1 day work = 18 − (7 + 9)

⇒ C’s 1 day work = 2

⇒ Days taken by C alone

⇒ 126 ÷ 2 = 63

**∴ C alone can complete the work in 63 days.**
